names.note: The calendar’s own name page for her is «Фекла (Макушева), исп.»; the rank is stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Св. Феклы исп». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The year the day line closes with, «(1954)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 декабря ст. ст. — «Св. Феклы исп (1954).»

attestations.note: A line of her own, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS. «Исп.» is исповедница, a woman confessor, and the name page repeats it and adds no monastic grade, so she is recorded with `confessor` alone and no office. Her year, 1954, is the latest on this day. No folder held her: a Cyrillic grep for «Макушева» over every `saint.json` returns nothing, and the Thekla folders the corpus keeps are the first-martyr and others of far earlier date. The day page prints eleven hymns and none is under her name.
